name: @pipeworx/mcp-pangaea

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search of PANGAEA earth/environmental science datasets (oceanography, climate, geology, biology, paleo). Returns dataset title, DOI, authors, year, and topics. Use for questions like "ocean temperature datasets", "Arctic sea ice cores", "CO2 flux measurements".

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "ocean temperature", "Arctic sea ice". Omit to browse everything.

tools.name: dataset
tools.description: Full metadata for one PANGAEA dataset by its numeric ID (e.g. 921708).

tools.name: dataset_by_doi
tools.description: Full metadata for one PANGAEA dataset by DOI (e.g. "10.1594/PANGAEA.921708" or the doi.org URL).

tools.name: recent
tools.description: Most recently published PANGAEA datasets (newest DOI registrations first).

days.description: Only datasets registered within the last N days (optional).

tools.name: facets
tools.description: Aggregate matching datasets by a facet — top values of a category field (e.g. "agg-mainTopic", "agg-author", "agg-method", "agg-location", "agg-campaign") with counts. Optionally scoped to a full-text query.

query.description: Optional full-text scope for the aggregation.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pangaea forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pangaea pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
